facts.text: Founded in 1946 with only male students, the school became LeTourneau Technical Institute after it was suggested to establish a school educating returning World War II veterans at the vacated site.

sources.title: Founders - LeTourneau University
sources.quote: When told it was no longer in use, she suggested establishing a school to educate returning World War II veterans. The site became LeTourneau Technical Institute, founded in 1946 with only male students.
